summary: Prosus is investment company. Type: listed company. About 21,048 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $5.5 billion (2024). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 8 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 23 about funding; 2 about acquisitions; 4 about growth or hiring.

culture.text: Says more than 60,000 active AI agents help its teams build and move faster.
Staff come from UvA, VU, University of Cape Town, University of South Africa and TU Delft, studying economics and computer science.

open.text: Prosus N.V. and Prosus Services B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.

growth.text: Had 21,048 employees in 2024, with revenue of USD 5.467 billion and net profit of USD 1.3 billion that year.
Bought Boomerang and hired WeTransfer co-founder Nalden to lead its AI push.
Its Brazil unit is investing $4.7 billion to fend off competition.

worth_knowing.text: WeTransfer founder Nalden became Prosus's Chief Product Officer.
Ultimately owned by South African group Naspers.
